title: bonk~
description: attack detection and spectral envelope measurement

messages.description: poll the current spectrum via "raw" outlet
attack spectrum: loudness in each of the 11 frequency bands
instrument number if there's a template, velocity and temperature

flags.name: -halftones
flags.description: filter bandwidth of filters in halftones (default 6)

flags.name: -firstbin
flags.description: center frequency, in bins, of the lowest filter (default 1)

methods.description: set energy mask profile: number of analysis and drop factor
set number of frames over which to measure growth
nonzero turns spew mode on, zero sets it off
nonzero sets to alternative loudness units (experimental)
print out settings, templates and filter bank settings for nonzero
set minimum time (in ms) between attacks in learn mode
forget and learn for a given number of times (10 recommended)
set minimum "velocity" to output (ignore quieter notes)

body: [bonk~] detects attacks in an audio signal and measures its spectral envelope. It reports each attack with its loudness in 11 frequency bands, and can learn templates to tell different instruments apart.
